status_definitions.official-public: Official documentation supports the named operation/behavior to the stated evidence level; not proof of implementation, entitlement or user authority.
status_definitions.observed-internal: Sanitized local operational observation, not official public support or current tenant verification.
status_definitions.ui-only: Owner/UI setup workflow identified; not a public API operation.
status_definitions.unverified: Not established in reviewed evidence, conflicting, or integration-specific; disabled pending verification. Negative scope review is not a universal claim that the vendor lacks the feature.

source_url_policy: Official URLs are provenance values, not local Markdown links. Null means no official source exists for the local/integration observation; never present an official homepage as proof of an internal method.
